::: {#exr-decode-connectives}
#### What do these symbols mean?

Each table lists every combination of truth values of propositions $P$ and $Q$
(T for true, F for false),
and the truth value of a new proposition built from them.
Describe in words when each new proposition is true.

| $P$ | $Q$ | $P \land Q$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | T | T |
| T | F | F |
| F | T | F |
| F | F | F |

| $P$ | $Q$ | $P \lor Q$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | T | T |
| T | F | T |
| F | T | T |
| F | F | F |

| $P$ | $\neg P$ |
|:---:|:---:|
| T | F |
| F | T |

:::
